protocol.cross_validation: leave-one-episode-out; train on two episode ledgers, predict third; rotate all three
protocol.prediction: exact successor public digest from current public before digest/action and optional preceding selected public history

finding: For MG92, extra exact history reduces coverage sharply and does not increase the number of correct held-out successor predictions: 66 correct under all four key granularities. Public-state/action lookup covers 357/3906 and gets 66 correct; previous-action key covers 134/3906 and also gets 66 correct; adding the full previous transition covers 66/3906 and gets zero correct; two previous actions cover 132/3906 and gets 66 correct. Exact-key history therefore provides no demonstrated cross-seed benefit in this sample.
limitations: Three seeds per role/family; very small clustered observational sample.
Exact-key lookup is not a capacity-matched learned recurrent or Bayesian baseline.
More history creates more specific keys and lower coverage; abstention/coverage is essential.
Policy-selected observations/actions only; no counterfactual action outcomes or randomized memory ablation.
Public digest can alias latent state and may conceal task-relevant variables.
No inference of reward benefit, causal representation, or unfamiliar-family transfer.
decision: NEGATIVE FOR EXACT-KEY HISTORY AUGMENTATION. This does not falsify all compact learned belief-state mechanisms. The next genuine candidate must compress history into a bounded predictive belief updated by observed prediction residuals and contradictions, then prospectively compare memory-on/off with matched recurrent/Bayesian controls and terminal reward after authorized first-use.
